causal_chain.bug_semantics: The withdrawn report alleged that an attacker could begin an OAuth sign-in, reach an OTP challenge, alter the factor strategy in the attempt request, and complete authentication without the correct code. A browser can always alter its request, so the alleged bypass would require the Frontend API server to accept a factor that was not valid for the prepared sign-in state. The CNA subsequently rejected CVE-2025-63700 after determining that it was not a security issue.
causal_chain.flaw_origin: No verified flaw exists in clerk/javascript. At @clerk/clerk-js 5.88.0 the public SDK only sends the selected strategy and entered code to the Frontend API; the authentication decision and factor-to-state binding are server-side. The relevant client transport predates 5.88.0, and the authoritative rejection establishes no vulnerable server behavior or repository-local origin.

causal_chain.bug_semantics: Authenticated ticket routes accepted a user-controlled numeric ticket id without constraining the selected Ticket to the authenticated user's company_id. GET /ticket/update/{id} exposed another tenant's ticket content and, once attachment support existed, its attachments; POST /ticket/save loaded another tenant's Ticket and then reassigned company_id and saved it; GET /ticket/delete/{id} deleted an arbitrary Ticket while its generic Request type also bypassed TicketDeleteRequest authorization.
causal_chain.flaw_origin: Commit 2feef9f35593dba39525f6a8a07b4cd3f74f19bd is the smallest real BIC: it created the reachable ticket update and save routes and controllers with Ticket::find($id) and Ticket::find($request->id), respectively, without tenant scoping. Commit 946a0c5e43a1178534e5b013ea2608d565686220 later expanded the same object-ownership flaw to deletion, and 626b0228c248637086ce91bb17b2ec1b1c21961b later expanded read impact to attachments. Commit 65f6b9f961efe533b4d3f20f1eddad132fe8ef1d merely moved the already-vulnerable save lookup into TicketRepository and is not an introducer.

audit_record.bug_semantics: Authenticated ticket routes accepted a user-controlled numeric ticket id without constraining the selected Ticket to the authenticated user's company_id. evidence: The assigned advisory bundle says the flaw affects versions before 5.4.9 and directly references b2b6ffdace0972ab62d1f7e8cdab0ed213bfc4a9. `git show --format=fuller b2b6ffdace0972ab62d1f7e8cdab0ed213bfc4a9` confirms that this direct patch replaces all three unscoped selections with id-plus-authenticated-company queries ending in firstOrFail() and changes TicketDeleteController from generic Request to TicketDeleteRequest.

`git show --format=fuller 2feef9f35593dba39525f6a8a07b4cd3f74f19bd -- app/Http/Controllers/Ticket routes/web.php` shows a one-parent `Tickets CRUD` commit creating /ticket/update/{id} and /ticket/save along with new controllers containing Ticket::find($id) and Ticket::find($request->id); the save path then assigns Auth::user()->company_id. This is an original vulnerable implementation, not an aggregate, import, move, or refactor.

Direct-parent verification: `git cat-file commit 2feef9f35593dba39525f6a8a07b4cd3f74f19bd` gives the sole parent 063d713c71ca6c453d43e7b17a9ee2f8b2fc0ce1. `git ls-tree -r --name-only` on that parent for the ticket controllers, repository, and delete request returns no paths, and `git grep -n -i ticket` on the parent's routes/web.php returns no match. The reachable vulnerable handlers are therefore absent from the immediate parent.

`git show 65f6b9f961efe533b4d3f20f1eddad132fe8ef1d -- app/Http/Controllers/Ticket/TicketSaveController.php app/Repositories/TicketRepository.php` removes the existing unscoped lookup from the controller and reproduces it in a new repository, rejecting that later move as a BIC. `git show 946a0c5e43a1178534e5b013ea2608d565686220` separately shows the later creation of the unscoped delete route and controller, while `git show 626b0228c248637086ce91bb17b2ec1b1c21961b` shows attachments added atop the already-unscoped update lookup.

Version-boundary verification: `git rev-parse b2b6ffdace0972ab62d1f7e8cdab0ed213bfc4a9^` returns 361566c1ddb01df16f2cff0aa836f04be174f3c4, whose version.php reports 5.4.8. The immediate follow-up 7e86b0845b14887b101a4516020fedafbff23564 changes version.php from 5.4.8 to 5.4.9 with subject `chore: update version after ticket security fixes`. `git tag --contains` the fix returns v5.5.3 and v5.14.0, and `git merge-base --is-ancestor` confirms the BIC precedes the fix.

The sole assigned disagreement was marker_state: the primary serialized an explanatory `absent — ...` string, while the reviewer serialized null. Re-running `git cat-file commit 2feef9f35593dba39525f6a8a07b4cd3f74f19bd` shows author and committer Gustavo Novaro <gnovaro@gmail.com>, one parent, and message exactly `Tickets CRUD`, with no Co-authored-by, Generated-with, bot identity, or other AI signal. Accordingly the reviewer's null marker state is canonical; the primary's substantive observation is correct but its explanatory text belongs in evidence, not ai_marker. Claude attribution on the later fix and version bump is excluded because it is not present on the BIC commit object.

causal_chain.bug_semantics: The POST routes /fetch_misp_event and /misp_search_events accepted a caller-controlled HTTPS MISP base URL and made server-side requests whose response data was returned to the caller. _validate_misp_url rejected unsafe IP literals but accepted every ordinary hostname without resolving it, so an attacker could use a hostname resolving to a private, loopback, link-local, or reserved address to reach and read an internal HTTPS service. The routes were also callable anonymously, increasing exposure, while the unresolved-hostname allow decision was the SSRF root cause.
causal_chain.flaw_origin: Commit b9f40af30de83fa44a14a3b0263df26192696b48 directly added website/web/convert/convert.py::_validate_misp_url and both outbound-request routes. Its ValueError branch used `pass  # it's a domain name — OK`, accepting non-IP hostnames without checking resolved destinations. The same direct feature commit added the unauthenticated request sinks; it was not an import, move, refactor, revert, release commit, or decomposed squash member.

causal_chain.bug_semantics: The authenticated GET /download-export endpoint concatenated the attacker-controlled filename query parameter directly onto export_path(), checked only file_exists(), and passed the resulting path to response()->download(). Traversal components could therefore escape the export directory and disclose any file readable by the application process; the demonstrated impact is arbitrary file read, not write or code execution.

Commit 5eda5fcf38a87a1ceb39762474df6c2211def9fb later made the flawed method reachable at /download-export inside the auth middleware group, but did not write the vulnerable path construction. The later import/export aggregate 9049917b3807924bb301f35635d17958b23888cd only added a separate template-download method and retained the vulnerable method unchanged, so neither later commit is the smallest BIC.

causal_chain.bug_semantics: A project-scoped owner member or lessee administrator who may PATCH a volume target but is not permitted by baremetal:volume:view_target_properties can change an unrelated allowed field and receive the complete updated target in the HTTP 200 response. PATCH authorizes baremetal:volume:update, loads and updates the existing target, and serializes new_target without applying the target-properties redaction used by GET/list, thereby disclosing pre-existing iSCSI connection data or credentials. POST had the same unredacted response shape, but its caller supplied the returned values; the advisory's confidentiality escalation is the PATCH disclosure of existing secrets.
causal_chain.flaw_origin: The original volume-target REST API commit c380e05dbf84079b01fb3b0ea099ef9b293b9b3d created an admin-only PATCH response that returned the complete target, so it is the latent response-shape origin, not the security BIC. Commit 000bc72cc29b8637df496f2e6768281606a27058 later rewrote the representation to plain JSON without changing that behavior. The vulnerability first became real in e870bd34d0ccacbaef7f4e4def2535eb28f822b9: that commit expanded baremetal:volume:update from system-only access to system/project owner-member and lessee-admin access, introduced a stricter baremetal:volume:view_target_properties boundary, enforced the new boundary on GET/list, and left PATCH returning the full target without the new check. This is the smallest causal commit inside the advisory's affected version boundary.

causal_chain.bug_semantics: After scoped access tokens exist, several privileged admin routes still authorize only on user.IsAdmin and omit RequireScopes, so a deliberately limited admin access token (for example echo:read) can call /api/inbox, /api/panel/comments*, /api/addConnect, /api/delConnect/:id, and /api/migration/*. Backup export is a stronger variant: /api/backup/export is public, reparses a query JWT, and rebuilds viewer.NewUserViewer(claims.Userid), dropping token type, scopes, audience, and jti before ExportBackup, so the same low-scope token can download a full backup ZIP.
causal_chain.flaw_origin: GitHub squash-landed PR #195 as 3f8fb150158723aca31df2ae937a1aa7b31ac254 onto 45693330c7733364027e0aa07c102c4f01aab88a; that mainline aggregate is not the BIC. The reconstructable PR member bf994ebfd5fe2e16b85ff64ad25147abd9ba99d7 first made limited-scope tokens mintable (AccessTokenSettingDto.Scopes, CreateAccessClaimsWithExpiry with scopes, persist type/scopes/audience/jti) while JWTAuthMiddleware and privileged services still bound authorization to userid/IsAdmin and backup export still rebuilt a userid-only viewer. Immediate parent 387667192911c86db1e1bcb3f544ce12d340ffdb has typed JWT typ but cannot mint a deliberately limited token. Later member b47fa1c75d890cd080e3f6699bbfca8cd8d4b939 added opt-in RequireScopes only on echo/file/setting/user routes, leaving the advisory surfaces unguarded. Pre-scope inbox routes (67b7093ffe3067bd420f0d2542f9ce18db83e244) and backup NewUserViewer(claims.Userid) (6b66ae6c318d19a851927cf183e2c0c8defa6c5c) are latent old patterns, not the security BIC.

causal_chain.bug_semantics: Authenticated Perm.Download=false user can GET /api/resources?checksum= and receive md5/sha1/sha256/sha512 of any same-scope file because resourceGetHandler's checksum branch hashes the full file and returns the digest with no Download gate (sibling raw/preview/subtitle/X-Encoding paths return 202). Content-hash oracle; does not bypass scope/path checks.
causal_chain.flaw_origin: original: v2 introduced Perm.Download and gated rawHandler, but wrote resourceGetHandler's ?checksum= branch without that check. CVE-2026-35606's later patch (1e03fead / PR#5891) gated Content and X-Encoding only; it did not write the checksum lines. Checksum HTTP existed in v1 (850c4a10, 2017) before any Download permission existed.

causal_chain.bug_semantics: XKB SetMap stack buffer overflow (CWE-121, ZDI-CAN-30161). _XkbSetMapChecks (originally ProcXkbSetMap) declares a CARD8 mapWidths[XkbMaxLegalKeyCode+1] stack array of 256 elements. CheckKeyTypes, when XkbSetMapResizeTypes is set, computes nMaps = firstType + nTypes from client-controlled request fields with only a lower bound (XkbNumRequiredTypes) and then writes mapWidthRtrn[i+firstType] / mapWidthRtrn[i] for i in those ranges. The firstType > num_types check uses > rather than >=, so a two-request sequence SetMap(firstType=0, nTypes=255, ResizeTypes) then SetMap(firstType=255, nTypes=10, ResizeTypes) makes nMaps=265 and writes mapWidths[255..264], overflowing into adjacent stack (symsPerKey[]). A local X client can crash the server or escalate if it runs as root. Fixed in xorg-server 21.1.23 and xwayland 24.1.12 by rejecting nMaps > XkbMaxLegalKeyCode+1.

causal_chain.bug_semantics: CWE-121 stack buffer overflow: CheckKeyTypes() accepts XkbSetMap key types with client-controlled numLevels in [1,255] and never clamps non-canonical types to XkbMaxShiftLevel (63). Those widths are stored in the server type table. Later XkbUpdateKeyTypesFromCore / XkbKeyTypesForCoreSymbols / XkbChangeTypesOfKey index stack arrays tsyms/oldSyms/oldActs sized XkbMaxSymsPerKey (XkbMaxShiftLevel*XkbNumKbdGroups = 252) via XKB_OFFSET(g,l)=(g*groupsWidth)+l. With numLevels=255, groupsWidth=255, indices reach 3*255+254=1019 and overflow the 252-entry buffers. Local X client can crash the server or escalate if it runs as root. Incomplete prior XKB overflow work left this CheckKeyTypes upper bound unenforced. Fixed in xorg-server 21.1.23 and xwayland 24.1.12.

JS '.' does not match line terminators and no /s flag was set. Later 42d25902 (2023) widened script/style/comment branches to [\s\S] but copied <.*?> through unchanged; that is an incomplete sibling fix, not the first write.

causal_chain.bug_semantics: Stored XSS (CWE-79) in winter/wn-backend-module Brand Settings. A user who holds backend.manage_branding can save custom CSS at Settings → Customize Backend → Styles (the custom_css field). That string is concatenated into Less_Parser input together with bundled custom.less, compiled, and emitted raw inside a backend <style> block via BrandSetting::renderCss() in modules/backend/layouts/_custom_styles.php. No HTML sanitization was applied to the compiled output, so a closing </style> (or other markup that survives LESS) breaks out of the style context and executes as HTML/JS on every backend page for every authenticated backend user. Affected <=1.2.12; first-party advisory names v1.2.13 / d28f0b9474af79cfaa80eeb9d691f7a7c4469720 as the patch (strip_tags on the compile-miss return). Editor Settings markup styles share the same sink but are a separately advised issue.
causal_chain.flaw_origin: First-write of user-controlled custom_css into the Brand Settings LESS compile-and-render path. On 2014-10-16, 1203043a457dee3c298d7dd54289a866234cbb74 changed BrandSettings::renderCss() from parsing only bundled custom.less to File::get(...custom.less).self::get('custom_css'), stored the unsanitized compiled CSS, and the backend layout continued to dump that CSS into a <style> tag. Immediate parent fbaab26bfbcfef96bac4802fd6dd62ec5557c8e7 still parses only the static LESS file. The custom_css form field already existed from the BrandSettings rename (9f5646d2733fc0cd29ecc115c5f2b3fc93ad2d3f, previous day) but was not compiled or rendered until 1203043. Later cache extraction (e7c33467), model rename BrandSettings→BrandSetting, and error-message escaping (c9dab67) are refactors of the same unsanitized return, not first-writes.

causal_chain.bug_semantics: Authenticated backend users can privilege-escalate by spoofing FormController form_context in POST (CWE-639/CWE-915/CWE-284). Users.myaccount is reachable at any privilege level; formGetContext() trusted post('form_context'), so a crafted save could switch context from myaccount to update/create, which exposes role, is_superuser, and dynamically added permissions fields and mass-assigns them onto the actor's own User row. No model-level beforeSave authorization blocked self-modification of role_id / is_superuser / permissions.
causal_chain.flaw_origin: Original October CMS FormController trusted client-supplied form_context when selecting which user-form fields to bind, and Backend\Models\User saved without checking that the actor may not change their own role/permissions/superuser. Intended myaccount restriction lived only in form YAML context filters and formExtendFields, both keyed off the spoofable context.

Parent d412ea685 is scaffolding only (no FormController.php, no Users.php). Same commit also added Users mysettings self-save and formExtendFields that skip permission fields only when context==mysettings, plus user/fields.yaml permissions[superuser] and groups gated by context [create, update]. 94a4ccb6 later opened mysettings to any authenticated user; b121e036 began passing myaccount context into update_onSave, after which spoofing form_context was required. Direct fix d69e8415 (Luke Towers, 2026-02-20) stops trusting POST in formGetContext (`return $this->context`), binds initForm context from the server argument, and adds User::beforeSave rules blocking self-escalation, manage_users-less edits of others, and non-superuser superuser grants. Ancestor of v1.2.12, not of v1.2.11. Equivalent backports: 76b57bcc (v1.1.12, not v1.1.11), 7d625870 (v1.0.477, not v1.0.476). BIC commit object has no Co-Authored-By / Generated-with / bot identity.

audit_record.reasoning: Vulnerability-first: the patched line is formGetContext trusting post('form_context'), which selects the form definition and is the same value Users::formExtendFields uses to decide whether to attach the permissions editor. Combined with myaccount (requiredPermissions nulled) this is a client-controlled key into privileged mass-assignment on the actor's User model. git log -L finds no later rewrite of that return; 71a5dd67 is the first write in public history. causal_chain.bug_semantics: CWE-502 unsafe Java deserialization: ConnectionPoolDataSource.userOverridesAsString was a writable JavaBean/JNDI property stored as HexAsciiSerializedMap (hex of a serialized Map). parseUserOverridesAsString() hex-decoded then SerializableUtils.fromByteArray(), so anyone who could set the property (JNDI Reference, serialized bean, or reconfiguration) could inject gadgets. Nested IndirectlySerialized javax.naming.Reference values plus mchange-commons-java's ungated remote factoryClassLocation turned that into remote class load / RCE. Fixed in 0.12.0 by replacing the hex-serialized format with CSV.
causal_chain.flaw_origin: Original 0.9.1-pre5 feature: per-user config overrides encoded as Java-serialized hex on a public bean property, not a later regression or incomplete patch.

causal_chain.bug_semantics: Script/Code block client execution runs attacker-controlled JavaScript in the builder preview via Function/AsyncFunction in the page context. A victim who opens/imports a malicious typebot and clicks Run/Preview executes that script with their app.typebot.io session cookies, so fetch(..., {credentials:'include'}) can call credentials.listCredentials/getCredentials and exfiltrate plaintext OpenAI keys, OAuth tokens, and SMTP passwords. User-scope getCredentials already filtered by userId at v3.13.1; workspace-scope lookup fetched credentials by id without workspaceId (IDOR) but the GHSA-named closing fix is the imported-bot preview sandbox, not that query.
causal_chain.flaw_origin: First write of the Code step executor in packages/bot-engine/src/services/logic.ts: Function(step.options.content)() with no isolation. Later renames (Code→Script), folder moves, and the v2 packages/js AsyncFunction reimplementation carried the same sink. isExecutedOnClient (default true) only split a server path; it did not introduce client execution. Closing fix a68f0c91790af8f52f17557f4aa202e966e7e579 marks imported bots isUnsafe and runs preview scripts in a worker that omits cookies.

causal_chain.bug_semantics: CWE-22 path traversal in getFilenameFromUrl: UP_PATH_REGEXP on path.normalize(`./${pathname}`) only matches `..` as a whole segment, while the file path is path.join(outputPath, pathname.slice(publicPathPathname.length)). When publicPath has no trailing slash, GET /assets../.env against publicPath /assets passes the guard (dot-dot sits inside segment assets..) but the offset slice yields ../.env, resolving one directory above outputPath. Readable only if the middleware is backed by the physical filesystem (writeToDisk or custom outputFileSystem). Default publicPath auto -> / is not affected. Single-directory depth because a delimited .. segment is collapsed during URL parsing.
causal_chain.flaw_origin: Incomplete CVE-2024-29180 fix: the same patch that added the segment-only .. guard kept (and still uses) a fixed-offset publicPath strip before path.join, so a non-slash-terminated publicPath prefix can be sliced inside a path segment.

causal_chain.bug_semantics: OliveTin EventStream (Connect streaming RPC) registers any dashboard-authenticated subscriber, then OnExecutionStarted/OnExecutionFinished/OnOutputChunk broadcast InternalLogEntry (including Output) and live output chunks to every connected client with no per-action IsAllowedLogs check. GetLogs/GetActionLogs already filter with that ACL, so a low-privileged dashboard user can receive privileged action output (CWE-863/CWE-200).

Broadcast loops fan out LogEntry.Output and OnOutputChunk to all subscribers; AuthenticatedUser was stored per client but unused for authorization. A later commit only added checkDashboardAccess on subscribe.

causal_chain.bug_semantics: OAuth/OIDC consent CSRF token equals the iPlanetDirectoryPro SSO session id, and the SSO cookie is shipped HttpOnly=false (and, before the fix, without a SameSite default). Same-origin XSS can read document.cookie and both steal the session and complete attacker-driven consent in one step (CWE-1188/1004/1275).
causal_chain.flaw_origin: OPENAM-8575 (2016 ForgeRock) first-wrote CsrfProtection.isCsrfAttack to compare the csrf parameter to SSOToken.getTokenID(), and OAuth2ConsentPageHelper.getUserSessionId() to populate that csrf value from CookieHelper.getCookie(config.cookieName). Parent 3c076fc0dd1142d3c69fa39985667da2e1a8b628 has no CsrfProtection. HttpOnly=false in serverdefaults is older pre-existing default; the CVE-distinctive lines are the SSO-as-CSRF coupling.

The admin-console description field is a legitimate store; the missing output encoding in REST HTML is the generation flaw.

causal_chain.bug_semantics: Authenticated SSRF in the SMF image proxy (CWE-918). An authenticated user embeds an attacker-controlled HTTP URL in a BBCode [img] tag. Url::proxied()/parse_bbc auto-generates a valid HMAC for any such URL and rewrites it to proxy.php. ProxyServer::checkRequest() historically rejected only literal IP hosts, 'localhost', and the board host; it never resolved the hostname or checked the destination against private, loopback, or link-local ranges. cacheImage() then calls WebFetchApi::fetch() / curl_fetch_web_data, so a hostname that resolves to 169.254.169.254, RFC1918, or loopback is fetched. Redirect hops were likewise unguarded. NVD/VulnCheck swapped the branch mapping: git shows 4bf35cf on release-3.0 (WebFetch) and b4d23df on release-2.1 (fetch_web_data).
causal_chain.flaw_origin: dcbaefb0976cf3e9d9490455bb59504d5c807847 (2014-06-14) first added proxy.php with cacheImage() fetching the signed request URL via curl_fetch_web_data() and no destination-IP validation. Parent eb7314fc8e763023a2f02790669e1d224a6a74d6 has no proxy.php. The next-day commit a892a53ba45330d69b8ad8b1ede82aebaa29537b wired BBCode [img] auto-HMAC, completing the advisory attack path. Later hostname-only IP/localhost filters were incomplete remediations. 2022/2023 ProxyServer/WebFetch moves are refactors, not first-write.

audit_record.evidence: GHSA-rx88-8j23-4qxx / CVE-2025-67259 (NVD + GitHub advisory API) and classroomio/classroomio#642: authenticated student changes a captured POST into GET /rest/v1/course?select=...group(*,members:groupmember(*,profile(*)))... and receives other students, tutors, and course metadata. That select is the dashboard ID_QUERY in v0.1.13 apps/dashboard/src/lib/utils/services/courses/index.ts fetchCourse (supabase.from('course').select); list fetch uses POST rpc get_courses. v0.1.13 tag 876a785b3c467b809804f56e0981bff448fcfdb5 contains supabase/migrations/20231115082347_remote_schema.sql CREATE POLICY "Enable access to all users" ON public.course FOR SELECT USING (true) plus GRANT ALL ON course/group/groupmember to anon and authenticated, without ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY on course (only profile and a few other tables). Parent 78732f95f3372f3d2b0a1aca2e9be6af1a98a1cc has no that migration file. First git write of those lines is a0997b0b6951948efd7a8e8c5516c3d549f69cab (#19 local supabase dump; author/committer Rotimi Best <best@classroomio.com>; no Co-Authored-By / Generated-with / bot). df7a5818bb18d3bc7375edcd8bb0887e7e57bb29 (#399) later enables RLS on course/group/groupmember but keeps course SELECT USING (true) and adds group/groupmember SELECT USING (true); 0d0719e8f9ffa0d4ee85ab2fd116fe0055cd2486 (in v0.1.13) only tightens course SELECT to is_published OR is_user_in_course_group_or_admin, leaving published-course world-read plus nested groupmember/profile USING (true) (groupmember.email included). v0.2.7 bf614fd782d8b9e7d8685e660dfc0a4c981038f1 restricts profile SELECT to auth.uid()=id but does not close course metadata or groupmember expansion; v0.2.8 still ships PUBLIC_SUPABASE_* and client .from('course'). Closing fix: PR #622 inner f5c67b021c7f7496ffa85d76c470df97f9940857 deletes supabase/ (including remote_schema.sql and dashboard supabase.ts); parent 9aaba528525102c413f759eec83f6ce908956dfb still has them. Squash landing on main is 1e9a82e912736d87092715fae13329b76254d052 (in v0.3.0; not in v0.1.13). HEAD GET /:courseId uses courseMemberMiddleware (isUserCourseMemberOrOrgAdmin); PostgREST is absent from docker-compose.
audit_record.flaw_origin: original
audit_record.reasoning: Vulnerability is missing server-side authorization on PostgREST table GET, not HTTP-method confusion: students already had a JWT that PostgREST accepted; GET on public.course plus FK embedding dumped related rows whose SELECT policies were USING (true). The smallest first-write of those grants/policies in git is the 2023-11-16 remote_schema dump, not the 2025 squash revert that re-added the same file, not #399 (RLS enable that preserved USING true), and not rls_secure_courses (incomplete). BIC has no AI authorship markers, so NOT_AI. No dedicated CVE patch exists; GHSA is unreviewed and #642 was closed with no linked commit. The attack path is closed in source by removing the PostgREST/Supabase data plane and serving course reads through a membership-checked Hono API, first in reconstructable #622 member f5c67b02, landed by squash 1e9a82e91.

Affected: all versions <= 14.16.8; Wordfence title WP Statistics <= 14.16.8 Unauthenticated Stored XSS via utm_campaign.

Advisory attack path: plant via POST /wp-statistics/v2/hit because the signature is on the public homepage and base64 page_uri overrides sanitized REQUEST_URI so malicious utm_campaign is stored. First-party fix ref https://github.com/wp-statistics/wp-statistics/commit/6ab74427778b89c9e88471e9dd7407d9055a9b34. Wordfence also cites helper.js#L267 (wps_js.tooltip), class-wp-statistics-helper.php#L1462, class-wp-statistics-hits.php#L102, referred-visitors.php#L79, visitors.php#L94, class-wp-statistics-api-hit.php#L78 on tags 14.16.7 and 14.16.8.

v14.16.8 Helper::getRequestUri() (includes/class-wp-statistics-helper.php:1462-1468): REST + isset($_REQUEST['page_uri']) returns base64_decode($_REQUEST['page_uri']) with no sanitize_url; non-REST path uses sanitize_url(wp_unslash($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'])). v14.16.8 Hits::set_page_uri() (includes/class-wp-statistics-hits.php:102-104): return isset($this->rest_hits->page_uri) ? base64_decode($this->rest_hits->page_uri) : $page_uri. Hit::hit_callback() at includes/api/v2/class-wp-statistics-api-hit.php:78 calls Helper::validateHitRequest() then Hits::record(); permission_callback is checkSignature only.

Helper::getHitsDefaultParams() localizes signature = Signature::generate([source_type, source_id]) when request signatures are enabled, so the homepage tracker object supplies the unauthenticated REST hit HMAC. validateHitRequest() injectionPatterns() reject <script> and quoted on* attributes but not unquoted handlers.

Pages::get_page_type() default array always has search_query => '', so sanitize_page_uri()'s explode('?') strip (gated on array_key_exists('search_query') === false) never runs. FilterQueryStringUrl then keeps allow-listed params. includes/defines/query-params-allow-list.php default list includes utm_campaign. Visitor::get_page_by_id() sets params['query'] = Url::getParams(home_url() . uri).

v14.16.8 views/components/tables/visitors.php:89-94 and referred-visitors.php:74-79: Url::getParam('?' . $page['query'], 'utm_campaign') is written into span.wps-campaign-label.wps-tooltip title with esc_attr/esc_html; the sibling internal-link tooltip is '?' . $page['query'] via views/components/objects/internal-link.php (esc_attr). Vendor/CNA: OP-TEE optee_os affected 0 through 4.10.0, unaffected git 8794043c4065c26a2b8b1313794ba5ba5f06d296. Finder credit Argus Systems / ByteRay Ltd.

First-party fix and mechanism: OP-TEE/optee_os#7900 and commit 8794043c4065c26a2b8b1313794ba5ba5f06d296 (Shahriyar Jalayeri, merged 2026-08-06) add an explicit reject of TA_FLAG_CONCURRENT in core/kernel/ldelf_loader.c and ldelf/ta_elf.c. PR/commit text: flag sits inside TA_FLAGS_MASK so a user TA can set it; tee_ta_try_set_busy() skips serialization; concurrent memref map/unmap corrupts uctx->vm_info.regions and frees live vm_region nodes.

Named Fixes: tag c7c4b6e31b3ba5b1c92a50fc00680fc07755e4ef (2017-11-14, Jens Wiklander) introduced TA_FLAG_CONCURRENT (bit 8, comment 'pseudo-TAs only') and the skip-lock in tee_ta_try_set_busy()/tee_ta_clear_busy(). That commit is not the BIC: at its parent and until 387b0ee39, ta_load() still used optional_flags = USER_MODE|EXEC_DDR|SINGLE_INSTANCE|MULTI_SESSION|SECURE_DATA_PATH|INSTANCE_KEEP_ALIVE|CACHE_MAINTENANCE, so (ta_head->flags & optional_flags) != ta_head->flags rejected CONCURRENT for user TAs.

BIC 387b0ee39b1b8d5a8a0db68a0a4535d2d621342d (author Etienne Carriere, 2018-04-05) first wrote #define TA_FLAGS_MASK GENMASK_32(8,2) in lib/libutee/include/user_ta_header.h and replaced the whitelist with if (ta_head->flags & ~TA_FLAGS_MASK) in core/arch/arm/kernel/user_ta.c ta_load(), then utc->ctx.flags = ta_head->flags. GENMASK_32(h,l) is inclusive; GENMASK_32(8,2) includes bit 8 (TA_FLAG_CONCURRENT). Single parent, not a merge. git log -S TA_FLAGS_MASK -- lib/libutee/include/user_ta_header.h starts at this commit.

Parent-tree verification at 027f050651f1729eac3c50ecd8e8d3941463bf51: user_ta_header.h has TA_FLAG_CONCURRENT but no TA_FLAGS_MASK; user_ta.c still uses the optional_flags whitelist that omits CONCURRENT. Immediate parent therefore cannot accept a user TA with the concurrent bit. At the BIC, skip-lock already existed in tee_ta_manager.c and utc->vm_info->regions / tee_mmu_map_param already existed, so the UAF race is reachable as soon as the mask allows the flag.

Later loader rewrites are moves/refactors of the same check, not a new BIC: 7509ff7ce5e5a7679319e6fa059b71dd6f6cc8b9 and d1911a85142da16fef5ebdcdac0348d29ce37cd8 copied if (flags & ~TA_FLAGS_MASK) into ldelf/ta_elf.c and the kernel ldelf path; 486d6e395e6146bba6d45838e59a737494819ba4 moved it to ldelf_loader.c. Later TA_FLAGS_MASK expansions (GENMASK_32(10,0) through GENMASK_32(13,0)) still include bit 8.

record: The published CVE.org record for CVE-2026-33182 is PUBLISHED and states that prior to 4.0.0 an absolute resolveEndpoint URL replaced the connector base and received attached authentication material; it identifies 4.0.0 as the fix and links the vendor advisory https://github.com/saloonphp/saloon/security/advisories/GHSA-c83f-3xp6-hfcp.

git log --all --reverse -S'static::isValidUrl($endpoint)' -- src/Helpers/URLHelper.php identifies bef86d8bdec2deec452695cac9517b9ec0b63d7c as the first addition of the vulnerable early-return expression; the later matching change is the v4 repair.

git diff bef86d8bdec2deec452695cac9517b9ec0b63d7c^ bef86d8bdec2deec452695cac9517b9ec0b63d7c -- src/Helpers/URLHelper.php shows the atomic addition `if (static::isValidUrl($endpoint)) { return $endpoint; }`; git show of parent 161aadb2180a61691d7a6345830ca52531507c25 confirms that early return is absent and the parent joins the base and endpoint.

At v3.15.0, src/Http/PendingRequest.php assigns URLHelper::join(resolveBaseUrl(), resolveEndpoint()) to the destination, then resolves the authenticator and runs MergeRequestProperties and AuthenticatePendingRequest, closing the absolute-endpoint-to-authenticated-request path.

git tag containment shows the BIC is absent from v1.5.1, first contained in v1.5.2, and contained in v3.15.0; this also shows the advisory's unbounded '< 4.0.0' range is broader than the locally proven introduction boundary, while the real vulnerable lifecycle from v1.5.2 through v3.15.0 remains established.

Direct repair d418356b6257a847f92a0bfa0c2d48bb379c731d changes URLHelper::join() to throw InvalidArgumentException when the connector base is nonempty and the endpoint is absolute, and adds a regression test reproducing an attacker absolute endpoint; its parent still returns the absolute endpoint.

Commit 1307b1d72cacdd2c9c20978cdf7a0b720b4bf3bb adds the documented per-connector/per-request/OAuth allowBaseUrlOverride opt-in while preserving rejection by default; v4.0.0 resolves exactly to this commit, contains d418356b6257a847f92a0bfa0c2d48bb379c731d, and v3.15.0 does not contain the direct fix.

Advisory mechanism: Data API HTTP path -> constructed Rego query from a data document reference; path can inject Rego (oracle/misdirection/DoS). Fixed in OPA v1.4.0. References include https://github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/commit/ad2063247a14711882f18c387a511fc8094aa79c.
GO-2025-3660 symbols: Server.makeRego, stringPathToDataRef, stringPathToRef, Server.v0QueryPath, Server.unversionedGetHealthWithPolicy; introduced 0, fixed 1.4.0.

Fix ad2063247a14711882f18c387a511fc8094aa79c (Johan Fylling <johan.dev@fylling.se>, committer GitHub, single parent 24ff9cfb3ad0a6a5629f0b21458982d325ee03c5, message 'Merge commit from fork') is a single-parent public commit (no second fork parent in history). Changes v1/server/server.go: reject '"' in stringPathToRef, add parseRefQuery requiring a single ref, switch makeRego/unversionedGetHealthWithPolicy from rego.Query(ref.String()) to ParsedQuery.

Fix-parent v1/server/server.go: makeRego L2552 queryPath := stringPathToDataRef(urlPath).String() then rego.Query(queryPath); stringPathToRef L2685 interpolates URL-unescaped path segments as ast.StringTerm without rejecting quotes.
Fix tests document the payload: path foo%22%5D%3Bmalicious_call%28%29%3Bx%3D%5B%22 decodes to foo"];malicious_call();x=[" and is mitigated by rejecting string terminators in ref terms.

Pre-2017 Data API evaluated ast.Ref via topdown.NewQueryParams (no query-string parse). 3ebbeede6ce37a3e6db6aac380ba762388121093 first used rego.Query(path.String()); at that commit Ref.String() used "["+p.String()+"]" and String.String() was strconv.Quote, so quotes could not split the query.

record: The assigned GitHub advisory bundle identifies GHSA-vcrf-j523-4mrf / CVE-2026-13760 as OS command injection in aws-cdk-lib NodejsFunction Docker bundling, affecting versions before 2.260.0 and fixed by PR #38133 / commit baa9e1dff469306cc23b8f4bd232d703f98bf68a: https://github.com/aws/aws-cdk/security/advisories/GHSA-vcrf-j523-4mrf

The CVE.org CNA record is PUBLISHED, identifies AWS CDK as affected from version 0 to less than 2.260.0 with defaultStatus unaffected, and links the AWS vendor bulletin: https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-13760 and https://aws.amazon.com/security/security-bulletins/2026-050-aws/

GitHub's PR #9632 API reports 276c322780a9a8c9c6e569509a90ba0a7bec0879 as the squash merge and lists 1a25fc6d99713313a21b65633f191b2307fa1d32 (`deps and tests`) among its 19 member commits: https://github.com/aws/aws-cdk/pull/9632

`git show 1a25fc6d99713313a21b65633f191b2307fa1d32 -- packages/@aws-cdk/aws-lambda-nodejs/lib/bundling.ts` shows the first unsafe replacement: it removes fs.writeFileSync(JSON.stringify(...)) and adds `echo '${JSON.stringify({ dependencies: options.dependencies })}' > ...` to the bash command pipeline.

Direct parent-tree verification at 0b60c499c54ca35dd18e59b47f6a1fb63870cbe9 shows dependency JSON written with fs.writeFileSync to a temporary .package.json and only the fixed filename moved by the shell; the data-bearing echo interpolation is absent.

`git grep` at squash commit 276c322780a9a8c9c6e569509a90ba0a7bec0879 finds the same vulnerable echo interpolation in packages/@aws-cdk/aws-lambda-nodejs/lib/bundlers.ts:147, connecting the atomic PR member to the public mainline squash; that aggregate is contained in tag v1.60.0 and later releases.

Subsequent history preserves the same mechanism across refactors: 39e22bd1749e3d9239bebe600b0ba6180abb18d8 moved it to lib/esbuild-bundler.ts, b2f4d86793abfd74033596bad2fc33ddc22d2ed8 moved it back to lib/bundling.ts, and 7a82850d8bec45f18791e269e988c5261d5238d4 is the later PR #11289 squash containing the vulnerable OsCommand flow.

`git cat-file commit 1a25fc6d99713313a21b65633f191b2307fa1d32` gives parent 0b60c499c54ca35dd18e59b47f6a1fb63870cbe9, human author and committer Jonathan Goldwasser <jonathan@goldwasserexchange.be>, message `deps and tests`, and no trailers or AI marker.

Direct fix baa9e1dff469306cc23b8f4bd232d703f98bf68a changes OsCommand.write from `echo '${data}'` to `echo ${posixShellEscape(data)}` and also shell-escapes file-operation paths; its regression test uses a dependency version containing a single quote and shell metacharacters: https://github.com/aws/aws-cdk/commit/baa9e1dff469306cc23b8f4bd232d703f98bf68a

Tag topology confirms the boundary: baa9e1dff469306cc23b8f4bd232d703f98bf68a is not an ancestor of v2.259.0 but is an ancestor of v2.260.0, while vulnerable squash history 276c322780a9a8c9c6e569509a90ba0a7bec0879 is an ancestor of v2.259.0; https://github.com/aws/aws-cdk/releases/tag/v2.260.0

git show of 52cda9caa003cafe87e14ae3721db5e16f6f111a shows that it added BLOCKED_RANGES, _is_ip_blocked, hostname resolution checks, is_safe_url, and the guarded requests.get call; _is_ip_blocked compared the parsed address directly with the blocked networks without checking IPv6Address.ipv4_mapped.

git blame at direct-fix parent cc5ce935cae339d6f5f624e981762d65e1c2d1fa attributes the vulnerable range table, _is_ip_blocked, resolver path, and is_safe_url path to 52cda9caa003cafe87e14ae3721db5e16f6f111a. That BIC has exactly one parent, 89abdc6855c84084c2d412205c0deff6b82bc593.

A local stdlib reproduction shows ipaddress.ip_address('::ffff:127.0.0.1') is an IPv6Address that is not a member of IPv4 network 127.0.0.0/8, while its ipv4_mapped value 127.0.0.1 is a member, proving the guard's bypass and the normalization mechanism.

Commit 3bae4108a3ba1e507727d5264697fd7303ba0b89 introduces _normalize_ip_address, applies it before blocked-range membership tests, rejects URLs without a hostname, and adds literal and DNS-result regression tests for mapped loopback/private/link-local addresses. Follow-up ad2a0511c52449ad4fec97a30f4848f92676bed7 uses getattr for Python versions whose IPv4Address lacks ipv4_mapped; it does not change the advisory's mapped-IPv6 fix mechanism.

Tag ancestry matches the CNA release boundary: v3.0.8 contains 52cda9caa003cafe87e14ae3721db5e16f6f111a and does not contain 3bae4108a3ba1e507727d5264697fd7303ba0b89; v3.0.9 is the first observed release tag containing the direct fix and its compatibility follow-up.

record: The GitHub advisory GHSA-wrwh-rpq4-87hf and CVE-2026-40245 describe unauthenticated disclosure of Traffic Influence Subscription data and SUPIs after the handler emits HTTP 400 but continues processing.

At introducer parent 61f725a76b313250f98801d06769478678fae79f, internal/sbi/producer/data_repository.go returns an HTTP 400 response immediately for malformed snssai and for an empty filter set, so the database procedure is not called on either validation failure.

Introducer fc6e50f8530f9e02778052fcf3a7ac0ad4ce6526 adds internal/sbi/processor/influence_data_subscriptions_collection.go. In HandleApplicationDataInfluenceDataSubsToNotifyGet, both failure branches call c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, problemDetails) without return, followed unconditionally by ApplicationDataInfluenceDataSubsToNotifyGetProcedure and c.JSON(http.StatusOK, rspData).

The introducer has exactly one parent, 61f725a76b313250f98801d06769478678fae79f. No pull-request squash/member aggregate or finer public member was found for this direct commit; later file moves preserve the same missing-return behavior and are not selected as the BIC.

Direct fix 86686276a7e226183ee786e3dd6714ec56c78fda, parent ce36d00028def38a98c1bf4e2be97645b544e93d, adds return immediately after both relevant c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, problemDetails) calls in internal/sbi/api_datarepository.go.

Release inspection shows udr v1.2.0-v1.2.2 use the safe producer-return implementation; v1.2.3 is the first affected udr tag, and v1.4.4 remains affected. In the superproject, free5gc v3.4.1 points to safe udr v1.2.2, v3.4.2 points to affected udr v1.2.3, and the latest inspected release v4.2.3 points to affected udr v1.4.4. The direct fix is present on udr main at db69aa0e5b827306d4b8f1420c98fc13300ead66 but is not contained in an inspected release tag.
BIC-only AI review found no AI marker in the introducer author, committer, message, signature state, or trailers; the OpenAPI Generator file header is not an AI-authorship marker.

The attack is TinyMCE-only script wrapping on the CMS editor, bypassed by rewriting html_content on the raw CMS POST; the backend stores the payload and the shop/admin renders it as HTML. The GHSA commit URL points at the review-attachment SVG sanitizer (f533b1cd), which does not touch CMS html_content; the matching fix is 0a9059d5, which applies the existing clean_content()/Purify helper on PageController store/update and is an ancestor of tag v2.3.10. git log -L on store() plus --follow file history traces the unsanitized persist to the first CMS commit b1285fa (2019-08-02). That commit's parent tree has no CMS package, so the vulnerable lines are absent immediately before it. Same-day html_content rename and later Admin/Vue request()->only rewrites are refactors of that persist, not a smaller first-write. The BIC commit object is a human Webkul author/committer with no Co-Authored-By or Generated-with trailers; AI is judged only from that object, so the verdict is NOT_AI.

Apache advisory: non-parenthesized discovery wrappers such as masterslave:vm://...,... and static:vm://... incorrectly pass validation, bypassing CVE-2026-34197. Affected: before 5.19.7 and 6.0.0 before 6.2.6; upgrade to 5.19.7 or 6.2.6. First-party refs: https://lists.apache.org/thread/7n97nddyw96w6ykldjv1h40jx86xdo0w, https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-v853-w46p-fv2h.

Mechanism: Jolokia /api/jolokia/ exec on org.apache.activemq:* BrokerService.addNetworkConnector/addConnector with e.g. static:vm://...?brokerConfig=xbean:<url> or masterslave:vm://...,...; VM transport brokerConfig loads ResourceXmlApplicationContext so singleton beans (Runtime.exec/ProcessBuilder) run before broker validation. CVE-2026-34197 blocked parenthesized composites (static:(vm://...)); this CVE is the no-paren residual.

URISupport.isCompositeURI (activemq-client/.../URISupport.java:294 at BIC) returns true only if ssp.indexOf('(')==0 && checkParenthesis(ssp). parseComposite private method else-branch (initialParen!=0) still treats the whole SSP as componentString and splitComponents, so static:vm://... and static:vm://a,vm://b are real composites at runtime but invisible to the validator gate.

record: The CVE.org CNA record is PUBLISHED and describes the unauthenticated get-client-id RPC waiter leak as fixed in 0.2.16; the bundled GHSA is not withdrawn.

The f5d03cac30baa3f9d066095962e08df3c61112ce diff adds RPC.requests/responses, this.requests.push(payload), and setInterval polling whose only clearInterval/queue cleanup path requires a matching response; it also changes the default connection path to await requestClientId({ws,rpc}). Its new clientId.js explicitly notes that missing timeout could queue unactioned promises and become a DoS vector.

Immediate parent d5cb93d5d6f5b7d8e77c998cf74125383d95232b has no lib/clientId.js and its RPC implementation has no requests queue, response waiter, or setInterval; its client-ID request is a plain WebSocket send, so the vulnerable resource-retention mechanism is absent.

The BIC has exactly one parent, no local pull/member refs, and ordinary author and committer metadata for Paul Jensen dated 2020-10-12; its message and raw commit metadata contain no AI-generation or Co-Authored-By marker. No finer public member is available, so no squash decomposition is applicable.
Commit 990461ee58370b5f1cc2c2c2f1efd827a08cecbd later copies the already-vulnerable JavaScript waiter into src/lib/rpc.ts during TypeScript conversion and is a migration, not the BIC.

In parent 6c97a4f2c5d0e69881c5d5710a17e60ca1dc37ec the TypeScript waiter still clears its interval and removes its request only after a reply. Direct fix 931576db3cdbf4f1583bd2c3c8759c4f4e032ab3 passes ws into waitForReply, installs a once('close') handler, clears the interval, removes the pending request, and rejects the waiter.

Tag ancestry excludes the BIC from v0.0.2 and includes it in v0.0.3; it excludes the direct fix from v0.2.15 and includes it in v0.2.16. The public exploit is a full-page GET to /generics/search/?section=home&prev_url=https://google.com, which requires Django's redirect() 302, not merely an HX-Redirect header. git log -S and -L show that `return redirect(previous_url)` and the matching section-reappend empty-query branch were first written in 61c54bbb22a35143ca4e794b1a59fb5273cceb85, a small non-merge commit whose parent 0a65b30d5eee860775ad342de9de731a6ac5b901 still lacks that sink (verified by git grep and the parent file blob). The 3214-file root dump 14ca797 is therefore not the BIC for this mechanism: it is a squash-like INIT, and a finer public first-write of the HTTP 302 exists. 61c54bbb is an ancestor of affected tags 1.0.0–1.0.2; the direct fix 730b5a44ff060916780c44a4bdbc8ced70a2cd27 is in 1.0.3 and absent from 1.0.2. No PR members were reconstructable for 61c54bbb (single parent; no linked historical PR). AI attribution is BIC-only: the commit object has human org authorship Horilla <support@horilla.com> / horilla-opensource and no AI trailers or bot author, so the verdict is NOT_AI.

record: The assigned GHSA bundle states that malicious non-matching $toMillis inputs cause superlinear backtracking in the ISO-8601 validation regex, identifies affected ranges >=2.0.0,<2.2.0 and <1.8.9, and names patched versions 2.2.0 and 1.8.9.

CVE.org API record CVE-2026-52746 was PUBLISHED when checked and independently describes the same $toMillis superlinear-backtracking denial of service, the same affected ranges, and fixes in 2.2.0 and 1.8.9; it is not rejected or withdrawn.

git show c1721bfacb9a13833248309aa31fe3478b04bc41 -- src/datetime.js shows that commit adding iso8601regex with (-[01]\d)*, (-[0-3]\d)*, and (T...)* plus toMillis(timestamp, picture), whose no-picture branch calls iso8601regex.test(timestamp).
git show 5e65aff620167854810cde88c2a2580403d9eb38:src/datetime.js followed by searches for iso8601regex and function toMillis finds neither, directly verifying immediate-parent absence.

git log --all --reverse -S of the vulnerable regex in src/datetime.js returns c1721bfacb9a13833248309aa31fe3478b04bc41 as its first addition, d6ffc17cb16a8e53c222205bd274624e919cce0b as the mainline removal, and f659e42c24e680f61b3c449dc0415b918a020869 as the v1 backport removal.

git rev-list --parents -n 1 shows c1721bfacb9a13833248309aa31fe3478b04bc41 has the single parent 5e65aff620167854810cde88c2a2580403d9eb38; the full commit object contains no squash-member list or AI-authorship trailer.

git tag --contains c1721bfacb9a13833248309aa31fe3478b04bc41 starts at v1.6.0 and includes v1.8.8 and all inspected v2 releases; v1.5.4 lacks iso8601regex/toMillis, establishing the vulnerable feature's release boundary rather than treating older function-absent tags as vulnerable code.

git show d6ffc17cb16a8e53c222205bd274624e919cce0b -- src/datetime.js shows the direct mainline fix changing all three repeated ISO-8601 component groups from * to ?, eliminating the repeated optional groups responsible for the backtracking mechanism.

git merge-base --is-ancestor verifies d6ffc17cb16a8e53c222205bd274624e919cce0b is in v2.2.0 but not v2.1.1; the equivalent v1 backport f659e42c24e680f61b3c449dc0415b918a020869 is in v1.8.9 but not v1.8.8.

record: The Rust Security Response Team advisory https://blog.rust-lang.org/2026/05/25/cve-2026-5223/ states that a crafted third-party-registry tarball can extract one level below its own cache directory and overwrite another crate's cached source; crates.io is not affected because it forbids symlinks; all Cargo versions shipped before Rust 1.96.0 are affected.

The authoritative CVE.org record returned by https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-5223 is PUBLISHED, identifies Rust Project Cargo versions >=1.0.0 and <1.96.0 as affected, and names Rust 1.96.0's rejection of all tar symlinks as the solution; there is no rejected or withdrawn vendor disposition.

git log -L 168,182:src/cargo/sources/registry.rs 9fba127e4feafdece943637a85ab67fa7af02b02 and git diff 9fba127e4feafdece943637a85ab67fa7af02b02^ 9fba127e4feafdece943637a85ab67fa7af02b02 -- src/cargo/sources/registry.rs show that 9fba127e4feafdece943637a85ab67fa7af02b02 replaced the parent loop using File::create plus io::util::copy with tar.unpack(&dst.dir_path()), explicitly to preserve archive metadata such as executable bits.

Direct parent-tree verification with git show 9fba127e4feafdece943637a85ab67fa7af02b02^:src/cargo/sources/registry.rs shows no Archive::unpack or entry.unpack call: each member becomes an ordinary File::create destination and its bytes are copied. The vulnerable symlink-materialization mechanism is therefore absent at parent 99c8768f801457fac6f56a6c1fe676e6d63aa529.

git show 0b9e38225957337997cde1270b3ad5f84a14182a^:src/cargo/sources/registry/mod.rs and git show 0b9e38225957337997cde1270b3ad5f84a14182a:src/cargo/sources/registry/mod.rs show the 2017 hardening changed Archive::unpack into a lexical starts_with(prefix) check followed by entry.unpack_in(parent), but added no entry-type rejection; an in-prefix symlink plus later in-prefix path could therefore still escape through the filesystem.

git show 312d5575ac924de000b3582ed0e7520dea216894 -- src/cargo/sources/registry/mod.rs shows the direct fix adding an EntryType check before unpacking and allowing only Regular or Directory entries, so symlinks and other unexpected types are rejected.

Release topology checks show 9fba127e4feafdece943637a85ab67fa7af02b02 is an ancestor of Cargo tag 0.1.0; 312d5575ac924de000b3582ed0e7520dea216894 is not an ancestor of affected tag 0.96.0 but is an ancestor of patched tag 0.97.0, matching GHSA's Cargo <0.97.0 / first patched 0.97.0 and the vendor's Rust <1.96.0 / fixed 1.96.0 boundary.

GitHub PR https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/pull/17031 identifies the CVE-2026-5223 patch, whose source commit is 285cebf58911eca5b7f177f5d0b1c53e1f646577; release-branch commit 312d5575ac924de000b3582ed0e7520dea216894 has the same direct patch and is the copy contained by the first patched Cargo 0.97.0 tag.

In the assigned full-history harden-runner clone, git diff e3f713f2d8f53843e71c69a996d56f51aa9adfb9 5ef0c079ce82195b2a36a210272d6b661572d83e shows src/install-agent.ts changing the Community agent download from v0.14.2 to v0.14.3 and src/checksum.ts changing its checksum; v2.14.1 resolves to e3f713f2d8f53843e71c69a996d56f51aa9adfb9 and v2.14.2 resolves to 5ef0c079ce82195b2a36a210272d6b661572d83e.

The advisory-linked 5ef0c079ce82195b2a36a210272d6b661572d83e is a merge of e3f713f2d8f53843e71c69a996d56f51aa9adfb9 and eb43c7b3fd5a30c42ff1ab84b494f1cc6c7cc3b6; eb43c7b3fd5a30c42ff1ab84b494f1cc6c7cc3b6 is the one-parent harden-runner dependency-bump commit titled 'update agent'.

First-party compare https://api.github.com/repos/step-security/agent/compare/v0.14.2...v0.14.3 shows direct source fix eae0164904494eeae61d68028d71779e188fbb14 adding UDP handling to netmon.go and sendto/sendmsg audit rules to procmon_linux.go; its parent is the v0.14.2 commit a33c48b038c7b6ac98c789579037e76204e082d0, whose procmon_linux.go lines 100-110 register only connect.

The same first-party compare places eae0164904494eeae61d68028d71779e188fbb14 before the v0.14.3 tag; the tag resolves to 689409c83f4ac2a559d1cc60278197f33c0bb83d. The v0.14.3 release explicitly lists PR #465, 'feat: enhance network monitoring for UDP packets'.

GitHub path history for step-security/agent procmon.go/procmon_linux.go reaches c793555005be99a734737f7bf8ebce54e545f3c6 as the first public write of the process/network audit implementation. Its patch adds '-a exit,always -S connect -k netconn' but no sendto, sendmsg, or sendmmsg audit rule.

Direct parent-tree query https://api.github.com/repos/step-security/agent/git/trees/794340760181b0a57396ae8eaa9a3235f472994e?recursive=1 returned truncated=false and no procmon.go or procmon_linux.go entry, proving the vulnerable monitoring implementation absent from the immediate parent.

First-party ancestry compare https://api.github.com/repos/step-security/agent/compare/c793555005be99a734737f7bf8ebce54e545f3c6...v0.14.2 reports merge base c793555005be99a734737f7bf8ebce54e545f3c6 and behind_by=0, proving the BIC is in the vulnerable v0.14.2 lineage.

Raw BIC commit-object query https://api.github.com/repos/step-security/agent/git/commits/c793555005be99a734737f7bf8ebce54e545f3c6 gives sole parent 794340760181b0a57396ae8eaa9a3235f472994e, author and committer Varun Sharma <varunsh@stepsecurity.io>, and message 'First commit' with no trailers or AI marker.

record: CVE.org CVE-2026-63223 (CNA GitHub, not withdrawn/rejected): prior to 4.7.4, is_image and mime_in do not independently enforce a safe client filename extension; GHSA-mmj4-63m4-r6h5 withdrawn_at is null; advisory range < 4.7.4, first patched 4.7.4. First-party advisory also points at GHSA-2gr4-ppc7-7mhx (ext_in-only prior fix).

Pre-fix sink at 20ebcf4694d96d3c97fbc3938e360730e4f54618 system/Validation/StrictRules/FileRules.php: is_image uses Mimes::guessTypeFromExtension($file->getExtension()) and returns true when the type starts with 'image' (no getClientExtension check); mime_in uses in_array($file->getMimeType(), $params, true) only. HEAD UploadedFile::getExtension() still prefers guessExtension() (MIME-derived) over getClientExtension().

Fix b6e9a4fa1dca2df3d3f261bdf61532df8c6420aa (2026-06-30, Michal Sniatala, single parent 20ebcf4694d96d3c97fbc3938e360730e4f54618, GitHub 'Merge commit from fork', no public inner member). Adds hasInvalidImageClientExtension() to is_image (reject non-empty client ext whose guessed type is not image/*) and hasMismatchedClientExtension() to mime_in (reject when getClientExtension() != guessExtension()). Tests in FileRulesTest.php use GIF payload + name shell.php. Changelog v4.7.4 documents the prior MIME-only classification. git merge-base --is-ancestor: fix is in v4.7.4 (2bd0f01d2813f9ec06db42643ce39d9f5428bf6d) and not in v4.7.3 (723162211eb3c17f222f943c4610311dcf9167f1).

Parent f3d286b9e6ac38d39cdd1ef5c59742e34fe3a1b3 FileRules.php has only uploaded(); git grep on that parent finds no is_image/mime_in. Parent tree object verified via git cat-file -e. Single parent, not a merge/squash. At BIC, FileRules.php:109 is_image uses guessTypeFromExtension($file->getExtension()); :139 mime_in uses $file->getType(); contemporaneous UploadedFile.php:345-347 getExtension() returns Mimes::guessExtensionFromType($this->getType()); :373-391 getType() uses finfo_file.

Later history is copy/move/rename, not a new first-write: 9de62256ba0018c77989b4104a958e7585ec6129 renames mime_in getType()->getMimeType(); ad9462e565b2dc31774b88a715d931075e66809a copies the same MIME-only bodies into StrictRules\FileRules; 5ab9e9c63447a0afd01391a3b8ad005de06927d3 is a 290/290 line move of the implementation into StrictRules (non-strict FileRules becomes an empty subclass). git blame on the pre-fix StrictRules bodies therefore points at the move, not the origin.

29299349e7d232e9532767c7cefaed30957309be (GHSA-2gr4-ppc7-7mhx / CVE-2026-48062, v4.7.3) only rewrote ext_in to require getClientExtension() plus guessExtension() agreement; is_image and mime_in were untouched there, matching the later GHSA-mmj4-63m4-r6h5 write-up.

record: The published CVE.org record at https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-48487 states that versions before 0.149.16 are affected, describes attacker-declared RDLENGTH advancing _read_character_string/_read_string past _data_len and contaminating DNSCache/ServiceInfo, and identifies 544449596e645fcaad3834fa0cb614a54f847a82 and release 0.149.16 as the fix.

git diff 488de8826ddd58646358900d057a4a1632492948 e814dd1e6848d8c7ec03660d347ea4a34390c37d -- Zeroconf.py shows readString changed from struct.unpack of an exact calculated width to info = self.data[self.offset:self.offset+length], followed by self.offset += length.

Direct parent-tree verification with git show 488de8826ddd58646358900d057a4a1632492948:Zeroconf.py shows lines 511-517 using struct.unpack(format, self.data[self.offset:self.offset+length]); a short slice cannot satisfy the declared struct width and therefore raises before returning or appending a truncated record.

git log -L across Zeroconf.py, zeroconf/__init__.py, zeroconf/dns.py, zeroconf/_dns.py, zeroconf/_protocol.py, and src/zeroconf/_protocol/incoming.py traces the vulnerable slice back through moves, formatting, typing, and renames to e814dd1e6848d8c7ec03660d347ea4a34390c37d; tag --contains plus version sorting shows 0.13 as its earliest release tag.

git show ac081cf00addde1ceea2c076f73905fdb293de3a -- src/zeroconf/_protocol/incoming.py shows _read_character_string changed from calling the already-vulnerable _read_string(length) to an equivalent direct slice and offset increment, so this later optimization preserved rather than introduced the flaw.

reasoning: CVE-2025-66385 is a published MITRE/CIRCL record (not withdrawn) of privilege escalation in Cerebrate UsersController::edit before 1.30: an authenticated user can raise their role by supplying role_id on the user-edit request. The vulnerable mechanism is the self-edit exception grafted onto the existing validRoles checks. Those checks were introduced as a real control in b41b0dd (2022-02-19). On 2023-09-07, 5aefc37 implemented 'allow users to self edit' by (1) skipping the validRoles afterFind/beforeSave failures when the target id equals the caller and (2) adding the caller's current role to the dropdown after the closures were defined. CakePHP edit() only persists listed fields, and org/group admins already had role_id in the POST field list, so the beforeSave skip is a complete CWE-472 privilege-escalation primitive: self-POST an admin role_id and it is saved. The later $validRoles self-role insert cannot close that hole because PHP closures capture $validRoles by value. Line history and parent-tree inspection show 5aefc37 is the smallest first-write: its parent still has unconditional validRoles checks, the commit is not a move/revert/squash, and later 04322b2 only added fields/isset guards while copying the same self-id conjunct. The advisory fix c9bfa90 (also duplicated as 3f9fdb5 on develop) deletes the self-id conjunct and moves the current-role insert before the closures so self-edit of the existing role still works. c9bfa90 is the CVE-referenced SHA and the only UsersController change on v1.29..v1.30; it is absent from v1.29 and present in v1.30, matching 'affected < 1.30'. record: The Eclipse CNA record https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-1002 is PUBLISHED and describes network-triggered static-handler cache manipulation and availability loss; it marks Vert.x 4.0.0 through 4.5.23 and 5.0.0 through 5.0.6 affected.

Vendor issue https://github.com/vert-x3/vertx-web/issues/2836 demonstrates removeDotSegments("bar/../index.html") returning "bar/index.html" instead of "/index.html" and records that a bar%2F..%2F request caches a nonexistent file result, after which the normal file request returns 404.

git blame on d007e7b418543eb1567fe95cf20f5450a5c2d047^ for src/main/java/io/vertx/core/http/impl/HttpUtils.java lines 405-418 attributes both vulnerable pos != -1/delete branches to d5f646b101377ed2a842dfef00139b509b3bbd71; git show of that commit shows it added the complete removeDots implementation with those branches.

Direct parent-tree verification: d5f646b101377ed2a842dfef00139b509b3bbd71^ resolves to 5a79bf707794078a842800be5ba862a218e64c6c; that tree has src/main/java/io/vertx/core/http/impl/HttpUtils.java but searching that blob finds no removeDots method or vulnerable rule-C implementation.

GitHub PR 1780's public commit list contains d5f646b101377ed2a842dfef00139b509b3bbd71 as an ordinary member commit between parent 5a79bf707794078a842800be5ba862a218e64c6c and later feature commits; the PR was merged separately as a1554ffe52e11af376fcc04627b82e9e7e8cc796, so the BIC is not a squash aggregate requiring decomposition.

Commit e75a0a15aea7a575ebf865b3ed0839dfd4c3e52c is titled 'Introduce internal RFC3986 helper class' and copies the same pos != -1/delete logic from HttpUtils into vertx-core/src/main/java/io/vertx/core/internal/net/RFC3986.java; blame before the 5.x fix therefore points to this move, not a new causal implementation.

The BIC commit object has one parent and exact author/committer lines 'Julien Viet <julien@julienviet.com>'; its full message contains no AI authorship/co-authorship trailer. AI attribution is therefore absent on the BIC itself.

For the 4.5 line, direct fix d007e7b418543eb1567fe95cf20f5450a5c2d047 replaces each conditional delete with obuf.setLength(pos == -1 ? 0 : pos); it is not an ancestor of tag 4.5.23 and is an ancestor of first patched tag 4.5.24. The CVE.org record fetched from https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-48157 is PUBLISHED, describes the same title/description-to-HTML attack path, marks >=4.4.0,<4.15.2 affected, and names 4.15.2 as fixed; this is not a rejected or withdrawn advisory.

git log -L 31,35:Slim/Error/Renderers/HtmlErrorRenderer.php 4.15.1 traces both vulnerable lines directly to 4f84a8cee4ebc1e1a9ca56db6a04d51297385af1: line 32 interpolates getErrorDescription() into

, and line 35 passes getErrorTitle() to renderHtmlBody().

At BIC tree 4f84a8cee4ebc1e1a9ca56db6a04d51297385af1, Slim/Error/AbstractErrorRenderer.php:34-47 returns HttpException::getTitle()/getDescription(); Slim/Error/Renderers/HtmlErrorRenderer.php:32,35 routes them to HTML; renderHtmlBody() lines 86,94,99-101 places the unescaped title into <title> and <h1> and the description-bearing HTML into the body.

Direct parent-tree diff 941828c85cf323462271d5cde08f186c3dec016b..4f84a8cee4ebc1e1a9ca56db6a04d51297385af1 shows the first introduction of getErrorTitle()/getErrorDescription() and the two HTML sink calls; git grep of the parent tree finds no getErrorTitle or getErrorDescription under Slim/Error, and the parent renderer instead uses fixed literals.

ExternalUriInfo.java (introduced 896545f6501227f78a5bdddd984cc2df6d008314 by Dain Sundstrom) stores X-Forwarded-Prefix and does uriInfo.getBaseUriBuilder().replacePath(forwardedPrefix); it cannot change scheme/host. Commit message: feature only enabled when http-server.process-forwarded is true.

OAuth2Service.startOAuth2Challenge (tag 481): Response.seeOther(request.getAuthorizationUri()) — 303 target is the configured IdP auth URL, not redirect_uri. NimbusOAuth2Client.createAuthorizationRequest puts callbackUri into AuthorizationRequest.redirectionURI only.

docs/src/main/sphinx/security/oauth2.md: 'Set the callback/redirect URL to https://<trino-coordinator-domain-name>/oauth2/callback' when configuring the authorization server. RFC 6749 §3.1.2.3 requires the authorization server to match a registered redirection URI.

http-server.process-forwarded defaults false (docs/src/main/sphinx/admin/properties-http-server.md). Airlift RejectForwardedRequestCustomizer rejects any header whose name starts with 'x-forwarded-' with HTTP 406 unless process-forwarded is ACCEPT/true. Trino 481 depends on airlift 424, which includes that reject-by-default behavior (airlift#1183, 2024-06-05).

git log --since=2026-06-01 on ExternalUriInfo.java, oauth2/, OAuth2WebUiAuthenticationFilter.java: no callback-pinning or redirect_uri-validation fix; 60750e4e2a30e5784e39f3c4090da89a585c3ba4 only renamed ExternalUriBuilder.replaceQuery to fragment. GitHub PR search for 29754 / redirect_uri OAuth2 ExternalUriInfo returned zero hits.
BaseOAuth2WebUiAuthenticationFilterTest.assertRedirectUrl expects redirect_uri == serverUri + "/oauth2/callback" and Location host == Hydra IdP, not a caller-supplied URL.

record: GitHub advisory GHSA-h64w-w9pr-82m4 identifies crafted ICC mluc tags, memory exhaustion, affected exifreader >=2.10.0 and <4.39.0, and patch c9d88b67e127b2dcc7b46e328df468257fb2dc30.
The CVE.org record for CVE-2026-8813 is PUBLISHED and independently identifies versions below 4.39.0 as affected and c9d88b67e127b2dcc7b46e328df468257fb2dc30 as the fixing reference.

Git blame at the fixing commit's parent attributes the complete vulnerable mluc branch, including numRecords, recordSize, the record loop, result accumulation, and offset increment, to 86bab29b9ca12caaef904e05106c9f77b3159965.

GitHub PR #59 contains exactly one source commit, f31553373ee1881599b3fb9a641792e288b98410, with parent 8cb8ace0cf9c988572c89621dfc5348192b3370a. The source member and landed squash 86bab29b9ca12caaef904e05106c9f77b3159965 have identical tree 2a1e24dde0939406f3c82599719a157f764c9501.
The BIC adds src/icc-tags.js as a new file; its immediate parent has no such file. The vulnerable mluc loop is present in that addition, so no earlier public commit wrote these lines.

The direct patch c9d88b67e127b2dcc7b46e328df468257fb2dc30 rejects recordSize values below 12 and record tables larger than the available bytes, and adds focused regression tests for both malformed cases.
Repository ancestry confirms the landed introducer is contained in tag 2.10.0, the fix is absent from v4.38.1, and the fix is contained in v4.39.0.

git diff 80e905ef14eb17d43c454b65f1f9d4b9008c6743..3f6decef43ea5eebde2251ec5ea81b7eeeaa21ed proves parent absence and BIC introduction in both bindings: the parent has dir.child(credentials.getFileName()), while the BIC adds java.io.File.getName() and then dir.child(baseName).

record: The GitHub security advisory GHSA-pr7j-96cj-549h identifies CVE-2026-44025, affected fluentd versions <= 1.19.2, patched version 1.19.3, and unauthenticated disclosure of plugin instance variables through /api/plugins.json and related Monitor Agent endpoints.

git show fe73c272eed3c512c9ac31c0408c7c5e4d280451 shows the BIC deleting the configured debug_mode gate and adding query-string debug handling that sets opts[:with_debug_info] before plugin_info methods serialize instance variables.

git show of parent d7b53295286ab8cd23056e02562ca312264521e6 shows that instance-variable serialization existed only behind the agent's configured debug_mode; the request query did not control that gate.

git cat-file and rev-list show fe73c272eed3c512c9ac31c0408c7c5e4d280451 is a normal one-parent public commit, not a merge or squash aggregate; its sole parent is d7b53295286ab8cd23056e02562ca312264521e6.
Tag topology shows v0.10.32 does not contain the BIC while v0.10.34 does; v1.19.2 contains the vulnerable path. The advisory independently declares the supported affected boundary as <= 1.19.2.

Direct fix 990921518971699b9a97441970674d1800e29177 changes include_config and include_retry defaults to false, adds include_debug_info default false, ignores debug/with_ivars unless that server-side option is enabled, and adds regression tests for both disabled and explicitly enabled behavior.

GitHub PR #5392 records one source commit, 30fbbd74bccc5824b81a04fac197fb531512f106, merged as 990921518971699b9a97441970674d1800e29177 into v1.19; tag v1.19.2 excludes the merged fix and tag v1.19.3 contains it and lists #5392 in its release notes.

Apache JIRA https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/OPENMEETINGS-2812 says FileWebService.getRoomByParent needed more accurate access-right checks, explicitly says the issue was introduced in 3.1.0, records fix version 9.0.0, and links commit 7944f872a5e9763ed96533853fbf52cccd03b728.

In parent 7ca2996569c561220ecd23f18db9e80b0af5c1c6, openmeetings-webservice/src/main/java/org/apache/openmeetings/webservice/FileWebService.java calls performCall with only User.Right.ROOM and, for parentId >= 0, returns FileItemDTO.list(fileDao.getByParent(parentId)) without owner, room, or group authorization.

Direct fix 7944f872a5e9763ed96533853fbf52cccd03b728 adds a pre-call authorization predicate that resolves fileDao.getRoot(parentId) and permits only the owner, the matching room, or a user in root.getGroupId(); its TestFileService additions assert denial for another user's folder and grant for owner/group/room cases.

Tag 8.1.0 still has the unchecked fileDao.getByParent(parentId) path at FileWebService.java:335 and no fileDao.getRoot(parentId) guard; annotated tag 9.0.0 peels to bff7dfecd5044418471ffc3733f235226585ea06, contains fix 7944f872a5e9763ed96533853fbf52cccd03b728, and has the root authorization lookup at FileWebService.java:342 before the data query at line 369.

git log -L over the vulnerable method on the fix lineage reaches parentless root be2c8e450b634992366abab4d82145d8c9d745e1; the 3.1.0RC1 lineage instead reaches parentless root 7afb6b9ce7ca4d576fb29bd70868ad1ffff4af07. git rev-list --max-parents=0 confirms those respective roots, and both roots store the exact method in identical blob eb94012858482b2249177c98d3925b68d3fa73b3.

The pre-3.1 tag 3.0.7RC3 has only src/axis/java/org/apache/openmeetings/axis/services/FileWebService.java and no getRoomByParent symbol, while 3.1.0RC1 contains the vulnerable getRoomByParent and direct fileDao.getByParent(parentId) query, matching the vendor's introduction boundary.

record: The assigned GHSA bundle describes CVE-2026-29064/GHSA-hcm4-6hpj-vghm as symlink-target path traversal in src/pkg/archive/archive.go, affecting >= 0.54.0 and < 0.73.1 and patched in 0.73.1; CVE.org returned state PUBLISHED with the same affected range.

GitHub PR #3732 exposes five public member commits: fdfe01bd5a2302074ce4fca0d6e5c3453b19b457, 4fc1783af6eb18e54f6ed91766388672204dd281, 92b743d02930ce33571889fa585fb859bf2ebc11, 7c5cdf95f32dde5f24cf2be740f23a164735fd7c, and 9f3eeb8a0d5c65f8d72e240643cf522693c50cf9; GitHub squashed them into landed commit 7352f33964002080f35b277d900ac9c2a6f883f0.

The public commit object for 92b743d02930ce33571889fa585fb859bf2ebc11 reports the single parent 4fc1783af6eb18e54f6ed91766388672204dd281 and adds src/pkg/archive/archive.go. Its new handler lines 124-127 join dst with f.LinkTarget and call os.Symlink without a containment check.

Direct parent-tree verification: the 92b743d02930ce33571889fa585fb859bf2ebc11 diff marks src/pkg/archive/archive.go ADDED from parent 4fc1783af6eb18e54f6ed91766388672204dd281; that parent's archive implementation delegates Decompress to archiver.Unarchive and contains none of the vulnerable custom LinkTarget/os.Symlink lines.

Targeted git -S history in src/pkg/archive/archive.go starts the vulnerable f.LinkTarget and os.Symlink mechanism at landed squash 7352f33964002080f35b277d900ac9c2a6f883f0; commit 527bad4fda8fc665b75c1cdf43757f5194e4c69b later added strip/filter variants, while its parent already retained the default vulnerable handler.

Release ancestry checks show landed introducer 7352f33964002080f35b277d900ac9c2a6f883f0 is not an ancestor of v0.53.0 but is an ancestor of v0.54.0 and v0.73.0, matching the advisory's >=0.54.0 affected boundary.

Landed fix 93f9c33a9d4724ea3fa51d09a69e8b7f8525dc57 replaces direct os.Symlink handlers with os.Root-confined operations plus validateSymlink, rejecting absolute/rooted/volume targets and any path resolving to .. or ../ beneath the link parent.

PR #4674 atomic fix 11c7123dbedfc47af90880fe40e1e81ea2bf7835 and landed squash 93f9c33a9d4724ea3fa51d09a69e8b7f8525dc57 both produce stable patch-id 0ee85db3c81021d02b6fbeba680572ce5d59bb09, proving direct-fix equivalence.

record: GitHub issue #209, opened 2021-03-13, gives an authenticated archive.php request with report_type=website-search-reports and a time-based payload in order_col; the reported request sleeps for ten seconds.

At tag 4.8.0, archive.php passes request data to ReportController::showOverallReportSummary; controllers/report.ctrl.php copies searchInfo into filterList and calls viewWebsiteSearchSummary; controllers/webmaster.ctrl.php assigns searchInfo['order_col'] to orderCol and concatenates addslashes(unionOrderCol) into ORDER BY before database execution.

git show b8092087fd04ee3ac119f91d36cf1275fdb6a4b0 adds archive.php's webmaster-controller include, the report-controller dispatch, and the vulnerable webmaster report query together; git grep of parent 8436edbbab8792a043b1125459ff898a6800d675 finds no getWebsiteSearchReportSummary function.

Commit f9be6f464c3e06002b6c5d60d940004b61b7289b is a single-parent commit titled 'To fix #213 #209' and adds removal of spaces from searchInfo['order_col'] at the shared report entry point. Merge commit 440a00b6874152636669c4ebbbe12f92cd1e3fa3, titled 'sp 4.9.0 - sql injection fix', extends that filter to remove both spaces and asterisks.

Tag 4.8.0 resolves to 2e0fd822f8c613b65d81362cf3e252fd55ac7a6f and contains the BIC without either sanitizer. Tag 4.9.0 resolves to 7c107c789be74bdb284f857cd6a51877f0e0c11b, contains both fix commits, and the vendor release notes list security bug fixes. NVD and VulnCheck describe 4.8.0 as affected and versions before 4.9.0 as vulnerable.

The BIC is an ordinary non-merge commit with one parent, so there is no squash aggregate to decompose. Its raw commit object contains no Co-Authored-By trailer, generated-by marker, bot identity, or AI-tool reference.

Direct parent-tree checks at b70333fd58bceb0afa38fad7214e3ce55586c4c2 show src/joserfc/rfc7518/jwe_algs.py exists but contains neither PBES2HSAlgModel nor PBKDF2HMAC, proving the vulnerable mechanism is absent from the immediate parent.

record: The assigned GitHub advisory bundle for GHSA-gqw4-4w2p-838q states that malicious package metadata reaches Perforce::syncCodeBase(), that shell metacharacters in sourceReference permit arbitrary command execution, and that the fixed releases are 2.2.27 and 2.9.6; advisory URL: https://github.com/composer/composer/security/advisories/GHSA-gqw4-4w2p-838q.

The CVE.org API record https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-40261 is PUBLISHED and independently names the same syncCodeBase source-reference concatenation, affected ranges >=1.0.0,<2.2.27 and >=2.3.0,<2.9.6, and fixed releases 2.2.27/2.9.6.

git diff 3a3661a0b3ff307e5084fa4846c6e72feb904022 dd1fd0e306dbad073fa8b32c0b23eea52ada8dea -- src/Composer/Downloader/PerforceDownloader.php src/Composer/Util/Perforce.php shows one atomic data-flow change: doDownload() changes from $package->getPrettyVersion() to getLabelFromSourceReference($package->getSourceReference()), adds the @-suffix extractor, and passes that value to syncCodeBase(), which concatenates '@' . $sourceReference into the command string.

Direct parent-tree verification at 3a3661a0b3ff307e5084fa4846c6e72feb904022 shows PerforceDownloader.php lines 31-32 obtaining sourceReference only for $ref while the value passed to syncCodeBase() is getPrettyVersion(); Perforce.php lines 312-319 accept $label. The sourceReference-to-sync-shell path introduced by dd1fd0e306dbad073fa8b32c0b23eea52ada8dea is therefore absent in the immediate parent.

git cat-file commit dd1fd0e306dbad073fa8b32c0b23eea52ada8dea verifies a single parent 3a3661a0b3ff307e5084fa4846c6e72feb904022, author/committer Clark Stuth <clarkstuth@gmail.com>, subject 'fixed perforce to reference labels instead of invalid tags', and no AI-related trailer; this is an ordinary atomic commit, not a squash aggregate requiring decomposition.

git merge-base --is-ancestor confirms dd1fd0e306dbad073fa8b32c0b23eea52ada8dea is an ancestor of tags 1.0.0, 2.2.26, 2.2.27, 2.9.5, and 2.9.6. Tag-tree inspection shows the unescaped append at src/Composer/Util/Perforce.php:447 in 2.2.26 and :354 in 2.9.5, matching the affected upper boundaries.

Mainline commit 91f077050c13e49e22554b991c81378ce8b5ee16 directly changes syncCodeBase() from appending raw '@' . $sourceReference to ProcessExecutor::escape('@' . $sourceReference); it is absent from 2.9.5 and is an ancestor of 2.9.6. LTS commit 3448a8f255f14161ed8b10a1420e5c29f2637cfb applies the equivalent one-line direct fix, is absent from 2.2.26, and is an ancestor of 2.2.27.

Commit 4fcc13d428f28479b01f757341aadd625412b454, subject 'Convert perforce util to use array process args to avoid injections', replaces string command assembly with argument arrays and is an ancestor of 2.9.6; tag 2.9.6 has syncCodeBase() append sourceReference as a separate argv element. Release boundary: https://github.com/composer/composer/releases/tag/2.9.6.

CWE-653, CWE-863. First-party fix URL https://github.com/traefik/traefik/commit/65ebf4b47fbdc33e3856803a5844a404e094d52d; patched tags v2.11.54 / v3.6.25 / v3.7.10.

git log -L :nameAndService:pkg/provider/kubernetes/crd/kubernetes_http.go first attributes the skip wrapping to 36a565a599986afa9e2636d1e3f008c807ee13ec (2026-05-07, 'Fix cross-provider ref check for Kubernetes CRD provider'). Diff: replaces unconditional DeepCopy+namespaceOrParentNamespace+isNamespaceAllowed with if !strings.Contains(service.Name, providerNamespaceSeparator) { ... isNamespaceAllowed ... } and changes the following gate to if !isCrossProviderNamespaceAllowed(c.crossProviderNamespaces, parentNamespace) && strings.Contains(service.Name, providerNamespaceSeparator).

Parent verification: git rev-parse 36a565a5^ = 28604083a41b6d6e8c206d71e0bce464bff1edb7 (exists). Parent nameAndService (kubernetes_http.go:417-426) always DeepCopies, fills Namespace, and calls isNamespaceAllowed before any '@' handling; the skip-if is absent at the parent tree. TraefikService still returns fullServiceName(...) on both sides; the BIC is the first-write of the bypass control flow, not a move of that return.

Exploit path at BIC: fullServiceName (kubernetes_http.go:458-476) for port 0 and pName==providerName returns provider.Normalize(fmt.Sprintf('%s-%s', service.Namespace, name)). With '@' names, Namespace is left empty, so Normalize('-victim-backend') == 'victim-backend' (FieldsFunc drops the leading delimiter). isCrossProviderNamespaceAllowed (kubernetes.go:1230-1233) returns true when allowList==nil.

Sibling guards already present at the BIC and missing from nameAndService: Provider.resolveReference kubernetes.go:437-441 rejects !AllowCrossNamespace && HasSuffix(@kubernetescrd); makeServersTransportKey kubernetes_http.go:296-301 has the same HasSuffix rejection. The security fix copies that guard into nameAndService.

Member b0017e44e89ceca7b2cb9b8dd25f2a504227c4b7 has identical tree 0387f386e3cadce8bce77e2654b0fab61471d4c4 and identical parent 28604083; git merge-base --is-ancestor b0017e44 36a565a5 is false (landing rewritten by web-flow). Tag membership (BIC 36a565a5): present in v2.11.46..v2.11.53 (affected) and v2.11.54+ (patched); present in v3.6.17..v3.6.24 (affected) and v3.6.25+ (patched); absent from v3.7.0, present in v3.7.1..v3.7.9 (affected) and v3.7.10+ (patched).
