GHSA/CVE list whole maintained lines (<=2.11.53, >=3.0.0 <=3.6.24, >=3.7.0 <=3.7.9) without a lower bound; those ranges are conservative relative to this first-write. Pre-BIC, isNamespaceAllowed+parent namespace fill made 'victim-backend@kubernetescrd' resolve to 'parent-victim-backend', which does not bind the victim TraefikService id.

Fix 65ebf4b47fbdc33e3856803a5844a404e094d52d (2026-07-28, PR #13573, author Gina A. / gndz07, base v2.11 parent 8f5213ed83628e16d36a4309337d8f3eba0819f5) inserts into nameAndService: if !c.allowCrossNamespace && strings.HasSuffix(service.Name, providerNamespaceSeparator+providerName) { return error }. Same SHA is the code-changing fix on all three patched lines (git tag --contains: v2.11.54, v3.6.25, v3.7.10). Adds fixture with_service_cross_namespace_kubernetescrd.yml (IngressRoute default referencing cross-ns-tr-svc@kubernetescrd TraefikService in ns cross-ns) and tests that allowCrossNamespace=false drops the router while true binds Service 'cross-ns-tr-svc'.

A connected USB audio device fully controls those IN packet lengths. Because playback then multiplies the stored frame count by the (often larger) playback stride, an oversized capture packet becomes an even larger outbound packet. The unclamped sizes are enqueued and memcpy'd into ctx->packet_size by snd_usb_queue_pending_output_urbs(), then consumed by prepare_playback_urb() (sound/usb/pcm.c) and prepare_silent_urb() to set urb->iso_frame_desc[].length and to memset/copy into the URB DMA buffer allocated as maxsize * packets. Before the Feb 2026 consumer-side cap, that produced URB submissions past the endpoint's hardware frame/packet limit and out-of-bounds writes into kernel-coherent USB buffers (C/I/A high via local USB gadget). record: The BIC patch creates internal/sbi/server.go and mounts factory traffic-influence routes through applyEndpoints without an authorization check; it also creates the six CRUD route definitions. The parent returns HTTP 404 for internal/sbi/server.go, proving the route boundary was absent.

The vulnerable release snapshots v4.2.0 and v4.2.1 both point NFs/nef at 5ce35eab62b49b46c02be55d0c8ab23ce0300bee, whose server.go unconditionally mounts the traffic-influence group with no auth middleware. The advisory's runtime reproduction at that commit reached POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE business handlers without a valid bearer token.

Direct fix c38a82fd01702b7297ab0b91d231d457edf53ff2 replaces unconditional mounting with ServiceList-gated groups, installs RouterAuthorizationCheck for models.ServiceName_3GPP_TRAFFIC_INFLUENCE, and returns HTTP 401 when AuthorizationCheck rejects the token. PR free5gc/nef#23 was closed unmerged; c38a82f is the single-parent upstream-main fix object, so the PR head is not used as the fix SHA.

The umbrella v4.2.2 tag points NFs/nef at 2969433db45e813d65af3f43fe16e6bba750824a, whose server.go still unconditionally mounts the routes without authorization. The first inspected fixed umbrella release is v4.2.3, which points NFs/nef at 6e27bc78a4696835da6d99d065696690701ba995; blame and source there retain c38a82f's authorization middleware. This code evidence conflicts with current GHSA/CVE metadata claiming v4.2.2 is patched.
CVE-2026-44326 is PUBLISHED and the GitHub advisory is not withdrawn; both identify the same missing-authorization mechanism and upstream fix reference.

First-party advisory https://github.com/thorsten/phpMyFAQ/security/advisories/GHSA-jmv9-23mw-mxpq (published 2026-08-04): missing parent FAQ authorization exposes comments, commenter PII, and attachment metadata. Lead PoC is unauthenticated GET /api/v3.1/comments/123 returning comment text+email for a group-restricted FAQ whose GET /api/v3.1/faq/1/123 returns 404 {}; additional surfaces are frontend index.php?action=faq (Access denied body, comments still rendered) and GET /api/v3.1/attachments/{recordId} (filename+URL). Vendor page https://www.phpmyfaq.de/security/advisory-2026-08-04 lists the same comments/attachments issue under Moderate and patches it in 4.1.7.

Vulnerable 4.1.6 CommentController::list (phpmyfaq/src/phpMyFAQ/Controller/Api/CommentController.php:82-93) filters recordId then calls Comments::getCommentsData($recordId, CommentType::FAQ) and json() 200 with no parent visibility check. Vulnerable 4.1.6 AttachmentController::list (same tree, lines 80-102) calls AttachmentFactory::fetchByRecordId and returns filename/url. Routes at 4.1.6 phpmyfaq/src/api-routes.php:61-62 and :96-97 are v{$apiVersion}/attachments/{recordId} and v{$apiVersion}/comments/{recordId}. Contrast: 4.1.6 FaqController.php:163-171 sets current user/groups and 404s when getFaqByIdAndCategoryId yields empty or solution_id===42.

Frontend 4.1.6 phpmyfaq/faq.php:220 always does $comment->getCommentsData((int)$faqId, CommentType::FAQ) even when Faq::getFaq filled faqRecord with solution_id 42 and content=msgAccessDenied (phpmyfaq/src/phpMyFAQ/Faq.php:645-656).

BIC first-write: git show 5611aa5356c9b80cedb8eef16f4d3dea44eb8987 -- phpmyfaq/api.php added case getAttachmentsFromFaq calling fetchByRecordId($faqConfig, $recordId) with no permission filter. Immediate parent 5d1c692d99300ebdc7c6782be08fdeff7a421fae has no getAttachmentsFromFaq/fetchByRecordId/attachments case in phpmyfaq/api.php (git grep empty). At that parent, getFaq already did setUser/setGroups + getRecord, and inc/PMF/Faq.php:671-703 getRecord applied queryPermission on faqdata_group/faqdata_user. Single parent, not a merge/squash. First containing release tag 2.9.0 (also 2.9.0-alpha3+).

Comments API first-write (lead confidentiality impact, not a move of the attachments handler): 9b518ea4ca9bd666f1064ea7396e2f6f999b8d4c added case getComments / getCommentsData($recordId,'faq') plus rewrite api/getComments/; parent 7ca2a6d0952ab0ebbd58a44fef968e736d40eb70 has no case getComments in api.php. That commit also documents JSON email fields. First stable tag 3.0.0.

Lineage to 4.1.6 (moves, not BICs): 0607413cb35dea259ac1cdb864fa3259640fad72 renamed getComments->comments and getAttachmentsFromFaq->attachments; 7cb8c2cde1df566fdee27e1ad649c6cb800285aa copied those switch arms into Api/Controller/{Comment,Attachment}Controller.php. git log 4.1.6 -L on CommentController list() and AttachmentController list() both terminate at 7cb8c2c (--- /dev/null). 5611aa53 and 9b518ea4 are both ancestors of tag 4.1.6.

Advisory mechanism: uint16_t accumulator truncates uint32_t TLV_SIZE() in seven OSPF TE/SR TLV parsers; crafted Type 10/11 Opaque LSA after OSPF adjacency causes OOB reads/crash. Finder credit: Kazuma Matsumoto (GMO Cybersecurity by IERAE).

Pre-fix parsers at d3e8aedb87671f38db59b0df908e25e1d4af027d^: ospfd/ospf_sr.c get_ext_link_sid:982 (uint16_t sum at 992), get_ext_prefix_sid:1060 (sum at 1069), ospf_sr_ri_lsa_update:1368 (sum at 1377); ospfd/ospf_te.c ospf_te_parse_te:2115 (uint16_t len,sum at 2122), ospf_te_delete_te:2344 (2351), ospf_te_parse_ri:2439 (2445), ospf_te_parse_ext_link:2752 (2759). Each loop does sum += TLV_SIZE() and advances with TLV_HDR_NEXT.

Pre-fix macros in ospfd/ospf_opaque.h: TLV_BODY_SIZE = ROUNDUP(ntohs(length), sizeof(uint32_t)); TLV_SIZE = (uint32_t)(TLV_HDR_SIZE + TLV_BODY_SIZE); TLV_HDR_NEXT = tlvh + TLV_SIZE. ROUNDUP(65535,4)=65536 so TLV_SIZE can be 65540, which wraps uint16_t.

No remaining<0 guard. HeaderObjectToken.len is 24 at the BIC and at v11.12.1.

BIC search: git log -L 112,159:lib/asf/AsfParser.ts at 5b7e69c82e0fd888497678f6b882d48969017450 (parent of the fix) plus git log -S parseExtensionObject. Adobe KA-27501 names the sink: ServiceInputProcessor::getConstructorData() previously processed all constructor parameter types from API payloads; starting 2.4.4-p16 / 2.4.5-p15 / 2.4.6-p13 / 2.4.7-p8 / 2.4.8-p3 / 2.4.9-alpha3 only simple types and *\Api\Data\*Interface are allowed.

Independent patch analysis (slcyber.io SessionReaper writeup) quotes the remediating hunk in vendor/magento/framework/Webapi/ServiceInputProcessor.php: after getParamType(), skip unless isTypeSimple($parameterType) or preg_match('~\\?\w+\\\w+\\Api\\Data\\~', $parameterType)===1, then convertValue(). Exploit path uses nested paymentMethod JSON to Magento\Framework\Session\Config::setSavePath.

Unpatched 2.4.8-p2 getConstructorData at lib/internal/Magento/Framework/Webapi/ServiceInputProcessor.php:228-260 has no type whitelist; line 250 is $res[$parameter->getName()] = $this->convertValue($data[$parameter->getName()], $parameterType). convertValue() for non-simple types calls _createFromArray(), which again uses getConstructorData + objectManager->create, i.e. unbounded nested instantiation.

git log -L 228,260:lib/internal/Magento/Framework/Webapi/ServiceInputProcessor.php on 2.4.8-p2 yields three commits only: fd6aa643d41a8b9eae1e24ba5aea87bb449e3ff4 (2018-04-22) first-wrote getConstructorData as $res[$name]=$data[$name]; f281a053938504331a277e83a7a1152dc5143636 (2018-08-07) replaced that with getParamType+convertValue (the nested-deserialization lines); 1530c69c642797ae87c68292559422b1fede627e only wraps missing __construct in try/catch.

BIC f281a053938504331a277e83a7a1152dc5143636 is a single-parent content commit (not a merge/release squash) touching ServiceInputProcessor.php, TypeProcessor.php, and TypeProcessorTest.php. At that commit getConstructorData is lines 173-200; the new convertValue call is line 190. Message: 'Support for non-FQN classes on web-API interfaces... fix for MSI-1524 and MSI-1537.'

Parent f1154d422580448df49ce6deaccf68c2c5af4b08 still has getConstructorData (line 173) but assigns $res[$parameter->getName()] = $data[$parameter->getName()] with no convertValue on constructor params (git grep convertValue($data[$parameter on the parent file: absent). Working backward from the removed fall-through (`ValidatorWithIgnoreNameMismatch` then `GetValidatorWithDefaultCertificates`/`ValidateWithDefaultCertificates`), git log -S and parent-tree checks show those validators and the default ConnectionFactory/HttpClientFactory wiring were first written in NCBC-3173 35aefa5d; they are absent at parent 867e88eb, which still used a null/.NET-default SslStream callback. 35aefa5d is a single-parent Gerrit change, not a move, revert, or squash aggregate. NCBC-3192 only widened who hit that already-written callback. Tag membership: BIC is in 3.3.0 and 3.7.0 and not in 3.2.9; the 3.7.1 tag contains 04d1679 and 3.7.0 does not. Vendor's 3.0.x–3.2.x listing tracks the related IP-as-TLS-targetHost default (hardcoded in 3.0, ForceIpAsTargetHost=true from 3.2.1), which the CVE text also names; that option was not the code NCBC-3993 changed and stayed true until 3.7.2. AI authorship is judged only on the BIC commit object: human RiPont/Richard Ponton, no AI trailers, therefore NOT_AI.

Vulnerable sink at v1.19.2 lib/fluent/plugin/out_http.rb:279-281: def parse_endpoint(chunk); endpoint = extract_placeholders(@endpoint, chunk); URI.parse(endpoint). write() uses that URI for Net::HTTP.start.

git log -S 'extract_placeholders(@endpoint' -- lib/fluent/plugin/out_http.rb yields a single first-write: 832c0c22427b91eaed17f824158807c0fa5b5737 'Add out_http plugin' (Masahiro Nakagawa, 2019-07-10). Original lines 152-154: extract_placeholders(@endpoint, chunk); URI.parse(endpoint).

At BIC, lib/fluent/plugin/output.rb extract_placeholders already gsub'd '${tag}' from chunk metadata when @chunk_key_tag; the helper was not introduced with the plugin. Later 611db3e8e5deb4a8ff627c57afd1586e498f34a1 only stripped trailing whitespace on the extract_placeholders line.

v7.1.2 non-JSON path: src/outfile.c:653-668 username memcpy without bounds (memcpy at :657, tmp_len += user_len at :659, separator at :663); hash memcpy at :713; plain memcpy at :755. Default OUTFILE_FORMAT=3 (HASH|PLAIN) at include/types.h:766. --show callers src/potfile.c:774/877/881 pass username/user_len and potfile_ctx->tmp_buf from hcmalloc(HCBUFSIZ_LARGE) at src/potfile.c:152. BIC acfc02ee8a04629c1318da1b21a98432546f09e4 is a single-parent feature commit (parent a750d41a602ba13086aba262af5fc53ec5436854), not a merge/move/revert/release squash. At BIC, CheckAuth (kernel/model/session.go) allows RoleAdministrator/RoleEditor/RoleReader. CheckReadonly aborts when util.ReadOnly or IsReadOnlyRoleContext (RoleReader/RoleVisitor). Sibling getAttributeViewKeys (kernel/api/av.go:1107-1131) already filtered via FilterBlockAttributeViewKeysByPublishAccess for read-only roles; the new handler did not.

HEAD still has CheckAuth+CheckReadonly at kernel/api/router.go:572.

record: The HashiCorp HCSEC-2026-14 bulletin and the PUBLISHED CVE-2026-6959 CNA record identify affected Nomad versions from 0.9.0 below 2.0.1 and fixed releases 2.0.1, 1.11.5, and 1.10.11; GitHub maps GHSA-3934-423w-4jq3 to the same CVE and fix.

Commit 2a09fd62c23880ff306499ae03fe64628d82a23f has sole parent 7939e3af3f36eb96278a5f96186462545c2887c0 and directly changes the FIFO opens to os.Root-relative no-follow operations, adds mkfifoat, and bind-mounts alloc/logs read-only. Its message describes both the host-file-read FIFO swap and logs-directory write primitive.

PR #4656 exposes 35 pre-aggregate member commits. Member dd220bfb36a03668102c9c727a5c97c638056a67 adds client/logmon/logmon.go and passes an allocation-controlled log-directory path to fifo.New; parent 6ab891313bb01f69a19411bda4d1625de3bbc447 has no client/logmon path. The main-history aggregate is 5b14d24bf4626bab420d00783d92bcf25e0b641e.

Local tag topology shows v0.8.6 at fcc4149c55399eb4979cd3fe3fb983cfe6c8449a does not contain aggregate 5b14d24bf4626bab420d00783d92bcf25e0b641e, while v0.9.0 at 28e768721992df5097203eea6e2b247abd56ca6f does, matching the vendor's lower affected boundary.

The v2.0.1 tag resolves to 5c11f948ba7e9e709abf7f2ab7895ba5b44feb39 and contains equivalent security backport 62bf44e1b1d2ccb9bf10c1338d803512f9dbd1d2; the main direct fix and backport have identical patch content. The vendor bulletin supplies the Enterprise 1.11.5 and 1.10.11 fixed boundaries.
